name: telegram-approval-callback
description: M18 G1 in-chat approvals. An Owner taps the Approve button (callback `approve:<id>`): the router-side interceptor resolves the pending approval via the same DB path the CLI uses and edits the card. A second, un-privileged sender taps Approve on another pending approval: refused with a 'not authorized' reply, the approval stays live. Neither tap writes an inbound row or wakes a runner.
